yes: E-76-10 (notebook); 'Images created with Nano Banana 2 carry … SynthID, an invisible digital watermark embedded directly into the image' (E-165-69); E-45-20; E-63-5
yes: 'SynthID watermarking (Always On) + C2PA' (E-12-12, Gemini API model card); 'include both C2PA metadata and a SynthID watermark' (E-77-8); 'enabled by default' (E-64-14, blog)
yes: E-75-7 (notebook); 'All images created or edited with Gemini 2.5 Flash Image include an invisible SynthID digital watermark' (E-141-14); on Vertex AI — 'built-in SynthID watermarking' (E-67-11)

Gemini API model card lists 'SynthID watermarking (Always On) + C2PA' (see the related core on whether SynthID can be turned off).

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The finished image goes to publication, to a client or to a platform with AI-labelling requirements; the author wants to know whether the file will carry an invisible AI mark, including after editing someone else's photo.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: The question is about the visible sparkle badge in the Gemini app or about C2PA metadata (see related cores); SynthID for text, audio and video is not about images.

оговорки.текст_en: On the Nano Banana 2 Lite model page the SynthID sentence names 'Nano Banana 2': 'Images created with Nano Banana 2 have all our latest privacy and safety features. This includes SynthID…' — Lite itself is confirmed by the launch blog: 'Gemini Omni and Nano Banana 2 Lite use SynthID watermarking.'
The watermark covers edited images as well as generated ones ('every image created or edited'; 'All images created or edited').
Detection limit that also concerns generated images: 'Not enough details to watermark' (e.g. very simple or abstract content) — see the related core on reading SynthID results.
The June 30, 2026 blog presents provenance marks (C2PA + SynthID) as on by default, with no mention of opting out of watermarking.
The SynthID page describes no user control over the watermark; every image from Google's consumer generative AI products carries it from creation.

Content Credentials are added automatically: 'If you generate a media file such as an image using a supported Google model, Content Credentials are automatically added and signed by Google LLC' — the page names no way to turn this off.

PRODUCT, not API: in the Gemini app / AI Studio only the visible sparkle watermark is removed for Ultra subscribers and within Google AI Studio; SynthID is kept on all media ('In addition to SynthID…').

The addWatermark switch and the seed/watermark restriction are documented only for Imagen (imagegeneration@006, Imagen 3); the release notes say nothing about watermark settings for Gemini image models.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The task asks for a 'clean' image with no AI traces, or asks whether the watermark can be turned off with a request parameter; generation runs via the API / Vertex / Firebase.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: The question is about the visible Gemini badge (sparkle) in the app, about C2PA metadata, or about verifying the origin of a finished image — see the related cores.

ядра.подтема: Imagen: addWatermark и seed (не Nano Banana)
ядра.ядро_en: addWatermark (boolean, optional): any image generated when the field is set to true contains a digital SynthID that you can use to verify a watermarked image; if you omit it, the default true is used, and you must set it to false to disable it. seed makes output images deterministic, but if the model supports digital watermarking you must set "addWatermark": false to use this field (accepted values 1 - 2147483647).

модели_различия.текст_en: not described — the parameter belongs to Imagen

оговорки.текст_en: PRODUCT (console), not API: 'A digital watermark is automatically added to generated images. You can't disable digital watermark for image generation using the Google Cloud console'; watermarked images show a 'Digital watermark' badge.

Release notes: imagegeneration@006 (Apr 9, 2024) — digital watermark on by default with watermark verification; seed can't be used while the watermark is enabled, set "addWatermark": false. Imagen 3 (Jul 31, 2024) — SynthID watermark enabled by default, verification available.
Seeded (reproducible) Imagen output and the watermark are mutually exclusive: reproducible images are only possible via the API with the watermark turned off.
The release notes document watermark switches only for Imagen and say nothing about watermarking settings for Gemini image models.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: Generation runs through Imagen, and seed reproducibility or an image without SynthID is needed.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: Generation through Gemini image models (Nano Banana): this parameter is not described for them and SynthID is always on (see the related core).

ядра.подтема: Что такое SynthID и как он встраивается в картинку
ядра.ядро_en: SynthID adds an invisible digital watermark to an AI-generated image; it is added the moment content is created, is imperceptible to humans but can be detected by SynthID's technology, and doesn’t change the image quality.

модели_различия.текст_en: 'imperceptibly watermarked with SynthID' (E-135-80)
'an invisible digital watermark embedded directly into the image' (E-165-69)
DeepMind SynthID page (E-138-*) — common to Google products, no models named
2023: the watermark for Imagen 'directly into the pixels of an image' (E-178-3) — historical context

оговорки.текст_en: Definitions: 'SynthID is a Google tool to watermark and identify content generated through AI' (DeepMind); 'Google’s digital watermarking technology that embeds imperceptible signals into AI-generated content' (blog); 'designed specifically for AI-generated content… identify AI-generated (or altered) content'.

Scope wording on the SynthID page: 'The watermarks are embedded across Google’s generative AI consumer products' — the page speaks of consumer products; coverage of API output comes from the API/model pages (see the related core on SynthID in every generated image).

NOT ABOUT IMAGES: SynthID also embeds watermarks into audio, text and video, and Google is bringing it to more media types including text, audio, visual and video — these parts do not apply to image rules.
Scale (as of Nov 20, 2025): 'We introduced SynthID in 2023. Since then, over 20 billion AI-generated pieces of content have been watermarked using SynthID'.
Google (Sep 17, 2024) invests in tools such as SynthID to help people understand how a piece of content was created and modified over time.
Historical (2023, Imagen): 'This technology embeds a digital watermark directly into the pixels of an image, making it imperceptible to the human eye, but detectable for identification.'

Google Photos post (2025) defines SynthID as embedding 'an imperceptible, digital watermark directly into AI-generated images, audio, text or video' — text included; verification in Gemini covers images, videos, audio.
Metadata is a separate mechanism: 'Metadata allows content creators to add additional context with original files.'

SynthID is a tool that embeds digital watermarks directly into content generated by Google's AI models; the digital watermarks are not visible to users and are used for verification purposes. Currently, it can be used to verify whether images, videos or audio were created or edited by Google AI tools.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The author or client worries that the AI mark will spoil the image (noise, artifacts), or asks whether it is visible to the eye.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: The properties of C2PA metadata or the visible badge in the Gemini app are needed (see related cores).

термины.значение_en: Google DeepMind technology: an invisible watermark in the pixels of an AI image plus a tool to detect it; Google's invisible digital watermark in the content itself (not in metadata); it verifies only Google AI content
not noticeable to people but detectable by SynthID technology

ядра.подтема: устойчивость SynthID к правкам и её предел
ядра.ядро_en: The digital watermark will usually still exist even if the image, video or audio is re-scaled, re-coloured, compressed or altered in other ways. However, there's still a chance that after many alterations the watermark won't be detected.

модели_различия.текст_en: 2023 (Imagen): remains detectable after adding filters, changing colours, lossy compression (JPEG); not foolproof against extreme manipulations (E-178-11, E-178-7)
E-211-23/24, E-293-25/26 — any Google AI media
DeepMind SynthID page, no models named

оговорки.текст_en: SynthID 'acts as a robust watermark that remains detectable even when the content is shared or undergoes a range of transformations' (transformations not listed).

Historical (2023, Imagen): designed so it doesn't compromise image quality and remains detectable after adding filters, changing colours and saving with lossy compression (most commonly JPEG); 'isn't foolproof against extreme image manipulations'; 'While this technology isn't perfect, our internal testing shows that it's accurate against many common image manipulations'; images 'and even some edited versions' can be identified later.
Historical illustration (alt text): the watermarked image shown modified by blur, grayscale, blue tint, rotation, color filters, noise and brightness — per-edit detection results are not given.

SynthID isn't a silver bullet for identifying AI generated content; it works effectively on its own but can be combined with other AI detection approaches, and it is not built to directly stop motivated adversaries.
For images the page makes a weaker claim ('designed to stand up to') than for audio ('can't be altered by common modifications'); no guarantee is given that an image watermark survives edits.
The image/video watermark is designed to stand up to modifications like cropping, adding filters, changing frame rates, or lossy compression.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: After generation the image will be compressed, resized or recoloured — will the AI mark stay; or someone asks whether the watermark can be 'washed out' by edits.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: A minor edit of someone else's image or a very simple/abstract frame is a separate limit (see the core on reading SynthID results); text SynthID and its limits are a separate core.

термины.значение_en: a watermark that usually survives resizing, recolouring and compression
a design goal, not a guarantee that the mark survives

ядра.подтема: история и масштаб SynthID (2023 → 2026)
ядра.ядро_en: SynthID was introduced in 2023, originally focused on AI-generated imagery only, and has since been expanded to cover AI-generated text, audio and video content, including content generated by Google's Gemini, Imagen, Lyria and Veo models; over 20 billion AI-generated pieces of content have been watermarked using SynthID (as of Nov 2025).

модели_различия.текст_en: 2023: Imagen only, beta for a limited number of Vertex AI customers (E-178-1, E-178-2, E-178-4); Imagen in 2025 (E-327-3)
Gemini, Imagen, Lyria, Veo families without versions (E-329-5)

оговорки.текст_en: 2023-08-29: Google DeepMind, in partnership with Google Cloud, launched a beta version of SynthID for watermarking and identifying AI-generated images, released to a limited number of Vertex AI customers using Imagen; developed by Google DeepMind and refined with Google Research.

2023 plans: SynthID 'could be expanded for use across other AI models', integrated into more Google products and made available to third parties; it 'could also evolve … beyond imagery such as audio, video, and text'.
2025-02: 'You may have already seen SynthID used to watermark images created entirely by AI — like those made by Google’s text-to-image model, Imagen.'
Scale over time: over 10 billion pieces of content watermarked (2025-05-20); over 20 billion (2025-11-20); I/O 2026: SynthID launched three years ago.

2024-05-14 post: 'last year, we launched SynthID, our novel digital toolkit for watermarking AI-generated content' — to address risks such as misinformation when AI content is not properly identified.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: A reference is needed on since when and for which models Google applies SynthID.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: Current Nano Banana behaviour and the 2023 mechanism are separate cores (see links).

ядра.подтема: механизм SynthID для картинок по статье 2023 года
ядра.ядро_en: SynthID uses two deep learning models — for watermarking and identifying — that have been trained together on a diverse set of images; the combined model is optimised for correct identification and for imperceptibility by visually aligning the watermark to the original content, embedding a digital watermark directly into the pixels of an image, imperceptible to the human eye but detectable for identification.

модели_различия.текст_en: Imagen (Vertex AI), 2023

оговорки.текст_en: Traditional watermarks aren't sufficient for AI images because they're often applied like a stamp and can easily be edited out — e.g. a corner watermark can be cropped out; highly visible watermarks pose aesthetic problems for creative or commercial use, while some earlier imperceptible watermarks are lost through simple edits like resizing.
Watermarking: SynthID can add an imperceptible watermark to synthetic images produced by Imagen.
Note: the model used for producing synthetic images in this blog may be different from the model used on Imagen and Vertex AI.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: It is necessary to explain why an invisible mark cannot simply be cropped off like a corner logo.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: Current statements about SynthID in Nano Banana are in the related SynthID cores.

термины.значение_en: the balance between watermark imperceptibility and robustness to edits

ядра.подтема: SynthID для текста и видео
ядра.ядро_en: SynthID is designed to embed imperceptible watermarks directly into the text generation process by introducing additional information in the token distribution; SynthID for video builds upon the image and audio watermarking method to include all frames in generated videos, embedding a watermark directly into the pixels of every video frame.

модели_различия.текст_en: SynthID for text (Gemini app and web), Veo / VideoFX (video)

оговорки.текст_en: May 2024: SynthID expanded to watermarking AI-generated text in the Gemini app and web experience, and video in Veo; starting 2024-05-14, all videos generated by Veo on VideoFX are watermarked by SynthID.
The method embeds an imperceptible watermark without impacting the quality, accuracy, creativity or speed of the text or video generation process.

Text only: the watermark is the pattern of scores for the model's word choices combined with the adjusted probability scores; it works best on longer, diverse responses, is less effective on factual prompts, survives cropping pieces of text, modifying a few words and mild paraphrasing, but confidence can be greatly reduced when text is thoroughly rewritten or translated.
Text only: Google planned to publish a research paper and open-source SynthID text watermarking through the Responsible Generative AI Toolkit.
Many AI detection tools rely on classifiers that often only perform well on particular tasks and can be unreliable across platforms and content types.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: Limitations of SynthID (translation, paraphrasing, short answers) were encountered and someone wants to carry them over to images — do not carry them over.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: Nano Banana images — see the SynthID cores on images.

термины.значение_en: the text SynthID mechanism — for text only

ядра.ядро_en: You can manage whether visible watermarks appear on AI-generated content in Gemini Apps: in the Gemini app or at gemini.google.com tap Menu > Settings > Settings and, next to Media Watermark, tap to turn the setting on or off. This setting controls visible watermarks across all visual media you create with Gemini, including images, videos, and music.

оговорки.текст_en: If you are in India, South Korea, or Vietnam, you'll only see this setting if you have an AI Ultra subscription; otherwise visible watermarks are automatically applied to all visual media you create with Gemini Apps.
These settings apply only to Gemini Apps (web and mobile), not AI features in other Google products.
When the setting is turned on, visible watermarks will appear on any newly generated images (Gemini Apps applies visible watermarks differently depending on the media).
This setting only controls the visible watermark; it doesn't affect SynthID watermarks or Content Credentials.

ядра.подтема: Что такое C2PA Content Credentials и чего они не гарантируют
ядра.ядро_en: C2PA metadata utilizes cryptographically signed metadata to provide secure and verifiable records of a media file's origin and any changes it's undergone; being cryptographically signed, this information is tamper-evident. C2PA doesn't classify media as "real" or "fake": it focuses on authenticating the source and ensures that the content hasn't been tampered with — even an AI-generated image is regarded as "authentic" if it has valid Content Credentials. C2PA doesn't guarantee the truthfulness of the assertions in the Content Credentials; the consumer of the media file is responsible for deciding whether the source is trustworthy.

модели_различия.текст_en: Agent Platform Content Credentials page (general) and Safety pages

оговорки.текст_en: Content Credentials include information about the creation process, the tools used, and edits made to a media file; if an AI tool generates an image, the Content Credentials indicate that the image was AI-generated.

Agent Platform Safety pages: Content Credentials 'do[] not guarantee trustworthiness of media source'; intended for 'media generation use cases, where transparency about the origin and history of the file is important for user trust'.

Blog (Sep 17, 2024): provenance technology can show whether a photo was taken with a camera, edited by software or produced by generative AI; Content Credentials 2.1 of the C2PA standard is 'more secure against a wider range of tampering attacks'.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: A client thinks C2PA metadata will 'prove the authenticity' of a frame or tell a photo from AI; it must be understood that it confirms only the source and file integrity.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: The question is which models apply C2PA, or what breaks the signature (see the related cores).

the source is confirmed and the file is unchanged; an AI image with valid Content Credentials is also 'authentic'

ядра.подтема: Content Credentials (C2PA): что это, что показывают и чего не показывают
ядра.ядро_en: Content Credentials are a technology that acts like a digital passport, documenting the digital content's origin and history, used for both AI and non-AI content; an industry standard developed by the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA). If the content contains Content Credentials, you can view a summary of media composition, edit history and whether or not AI was used, and the company that provided and cryptographically signed the information (e.g. 'Info by Google LLC'); Content Credentials don't tell you if a file is definitely AI-generated.

части.текст_en: A technology that acts like a digital passport, documenting the digital content's origin and history, used for both AI and non-AI content; an industry standard developed by the C2PA, supported by many products from different companies.
Media composition; edit history; whether or not AI was used; the company that provided and cryptographically signed the information (the result may list more than one company).
Content Credentials don't tell you if an image, video or audio file is definitely AI-generated; use the origin and history information with the content itself to make informed decisions.

модели_различия.текст_en: a standard, not a model

оговорки.текст_en: They provide details about origin and history through a standard that works across devices and apps from different companies, and information from the app or device maker about AI or non-AI tools used to create or edit a file.
Google collaborates with industry partners on content transparency and authenticity standards, including its role on the C2PA steering committee (YouTube, Search, Pixel, Photos).

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: It is necessary to understand what the recipient of the file will see in the image's 'passport' and why it is not proof of 'AI / not AI'.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: Which Google images get C2PA and the limits of C2PA verification in Gemini are separate cores (see links).

ядра.подтема: проверка C2PA в Gemini Apps: версии, ошибки, доступность
ядра.ядро_en: Gemini Apps supports Content Credentials versions 2.2 and later, from products on the C2PA Conforming Products List; credentials from products outside that list may not be considered valid or trusted, and Gemini Apps don't support remotely stored Content Credentials metadata. Verification with Content Credentials is available at gemini.google.com and in the Gemini app for Android; it will be available in the Gemini app for iOS soon.

модели_различия.текст_en: independent of the model

оговорки.текст_en: Content Credentials verification is available for image, video or audio files from devices and apps that support compatible versions of the Content Credentials format.

Content Credentials are built on history maintained and signed by each editor of the file; if the media history was tampered with or modified without an appropriate update of the C2PA data, an error occurs and the Credentials may be shown as invalid ('incorrectly modified').
A file may contain malformed Content Credentials when the app that generated it experienced a bug; Gemini Apps may detect the Credentials but can't interpret them ('unrecognised').

2026-05-20: verification for C2PA Content Credentials — to check if content is an unaltered original from a camera or has been modified, and by what tools — rolling out in the Gemini app, then Search and Chrome in the coming months.

ядра.подтема: как проверить картинку в Gemini app
ядра.ядро_en: Upload an image, video or audio file to the Gemini app (signed-in users) and ask a verification question such as 'Was this image/video/audio created or edited by Google AI?', 'Is this AI-generated?' or 'Is this a real video?'; Gemini will check for the SynthID watermark and use its own reasoning to return a response. You can only choose a single file to verify at a time, of 100 MB or less; for a screenshot, crop tight around the image and don't upload a collage of multiple distinct images.

части.текст_en: Upload the content to the Gemini app and ask a verification question such as 'Was this image/video/audio created or edited by Google AI?', 'Is this AI-generated?', 'Is this a real video?'
Gemini will check for the SynthID watermark and use its own reasoning to return a response that gives you more context about the content.
You can only choose a single image, video, or audio file to verify at a time, and it should have a file size of 100 MB or less.
If you're taking a screenshot of an image to verify, make sure to crop tight around the image to get maximum accuracy, and don't upload a collage of multiple distinct images.

модели_различия.текст_en: the check does not depend on the generation model; 'Google AI'
the check concerns any Google AI content; no models singled out

оговорки.текст_en: The verification tool is available within the Gemini app for signed-in users.

Launched Nov 20, 2025 ('Starting today… verify if an image was generated with or edited by Google AI right in the Gemini app, using SynthID'); DeepMind page: you can ask Gemini about an image, video or audio clip.
At launch: images and English-language prompts first; video/audio, more languages and more surfaces such as Search announced as coming soon (Nov 20, 2025).

Feb 26, 2026: the SynthID verification feature has been used over 20 million times across various languages to identify Google AI-generated images, video and audio; 'We’ll soon be bringing C2PA verification to the Gemini app, too.'
The check reports only whether a Google AI SynthID watermark is found; it is not a general AI detector, and a negative answer cannot confirm an image is not AI-generated (the page never says so).

(inferred by the extractor from future tense) Checking content from models outside Google's ecosystem via C2PA content credentials was not yet supported on Nov 20, 2025 ('Over time, we will also extend our verification approach to support C2PA content credentials').

ядра.подтема: как читать результат SynthID: найден / не найден / неясно
ядра.ядро_en: If a SynthID watermark is detected, it means that all or part of the image was created or edited by Google's AI models. If a SynthID watermark isn't detected, it means that the image wasn't created or edited by Google AI, but it could have been created by other AI systems. In some cases it isn't clear; common reasons are 'Not enough details to watermark' (e.g. very simple or abstract content) and 'Likely too small an edit' (minor alterations might not carry a detectable watermark).

части.текст_en: detected: If a SynthID watermark is detected, it means that all or part of the image was created or edited by Google's AI models.
not detected: If a SynthID watermark isn't detected, it means that the image wasn't created or edited by Google AI, but it could have been created by other AI systems.
unclear: 'Not enough details to watermark' (e.g. very simple or abstract content); 'Likely too small an edit' (minor alterations might not carry a detectable watermark).

модели_различия.текст_en: 2023 (Imagen): three confidence levels; «If a digital watermark is detected, part of the image is likely generated by Imagen» (E-178-16, E-178-15)
Gemini Apps help — 'Google's AI models' without names

оговорки.текст_en: In some cases, edits made using Reimagine may be too small for SynthID to label and detect — like if you change the color of a small flower in the background of an image.

Historical (2023): 'By scanning an image for its digital watermark, SynthID can assess the likelihood of an image being created by Imagen'; 'This tool provides three confidence levels for interpreting the results'.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The check returned 'no SynthID' or 'unclear', and someone wants to conclude that the image is real; or a very simple/abstract frame is generated and it matters whether it will later be recognized as AI.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: The verification procedure itself, or checking non-Google AI content, is covered by separate cores.
ядра.магнит_причина: Negative outcomes of the check ('isn't detected', 'wasn't created') and named failure reasons ('Not enough details to watermark', 'Likely too small an edit').

термины.значение_en: content too simple/abstract for a reliable watermark
a minor edit may not carry a detectable watermark
the watermark may cover only the AI-edited part of the image

ядра.ядро_en: SynthID Detector is a verification portal to quickly and efficiently identify AI-generated content made with Google AI, with detection capabilities across different modalities in one place; upload content, the portal scans for SynthID watermarks and, if a watermark is detected, highlights which parts of the content are more likely to have been watermarked — for images, it indicates areas where a watermark is most likely.

General access is via an early tester waitlist; the launch is dated only as 'Earlier this year' on an undated page.
Nov 20, 2025: 'we’ve been testing our SynthID Detector verification portal with journalists and media professionals'.

We launched the SynthID Detector, a verification portal, to verify if a piece of content was watermarked with SynthID. Just upload an image, video or audio file. We are currently collaborating with journalists and media professionals to test the portal.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: It is necessary to see which part of the image carries SynthID (for example after a partial edit).

ядра.подтема: Отказ модели: текст вместо картинки при FinishReason STOP
ядра.ядро_en: Model refusal: If a prompt is potentially unsafe, the model might refuse to process the request. If this happens, the model usually gives a text response saying it can't generate unsafe images. The FinishReason is STOP.

модели_различия.текст_en: the Agent Platform page 'Gemini image generation and responsible AI' — Gemini image models as a class
the Agent Platform limitations page names 3 Pro Image and 2.5 Flash Image (E-345-16); Firebase — all Gemini Image models (E-227-74)

Agent Platform pages (E-292-30, E-345-19)

оговорки.текст_en: Two different mechanisms: 'When provided with an unsafe prompt, the model might refuse to generate an image, or the prompt or generated response might be blocked by our safety filters.'

Gemini API FinishReason also has NO_IMAGE ('The model was expected to generate an image, but none was generated') — neither page says whether a refusal returns STOP or NO_IMAGE in the Gemini API (unit outside this part's input; belongs to the API/code topic).

When provided with an unsafe prompt, the model might refuse to generate an image, or the prompt or generated response might be blocked by our safety filters — two different mechanisms (filter blocks are a separate core).
The limitations page's only stated signal of refusal is the response text saying it can't create unsafe images.

приёмы.текст_en: STOP alone does not mean an image was produced: a pipeline should check whether an image part is actually present in the response.
After each call check whether an image part is present; treat STOP + text without an image as a refusal.

A model refusal comes back as text with FinishReason STOP, while filter blocks surface as BlockedReason or IMAGE_SAFETY-type finish reasons; STOP alone does not mean an image was produced, so check whether an image part is present.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The prompt is borderline (violence, explicitness, real people, children), and the response came back without an image but without an error — only the model's text.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: The image was blocked by a filter: then there is a blockReason or an IMAGE_* reason (see the filter-block cores).

термины.значение_en: a refusal by the model itself: a text response without an image, FinishReason = STOP
normal completion; a refusal also ends with STOP
the part of the response that holds the image; its presence indicates successful generation

response flagged → FinishReason IMAGE_SAFETY, IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT, or similar
Gemini API — IMAGE_SAFETY: Token generation stopped because generated images contain safety violations
Gemini API — IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT: Image generation stopped because generated images has other prohibited content
Gemini API — IMAGE_RECITATION: Image generation stopped due to recitation
Gemini API — IMAGE_OTHER: Image generation stopped because of other miscellaneous issue
Gemini API — NO_IMAGE: The model was expected to generate an image, but none was generated
Gemini API — PUP_LIMITED_DISABLED: token generation stopped because the user account is limited or disabled due to Prohibited Use Policy (PUP) violations
Agent Platform — FINISH_REASON_SAFETY: response flagged for safety reasons; Candidate.content is empty if content filters block the output
Agent Platform — FINISH_REASON_RECITATION: flagged for unauthorized citations; FINISH_REASON_BLOCKLIST: response includes blocked terms
Agent Platform — FINISH_REASON_PROHIBITED_CONTENT: flagged for prohibited content, such as child sexual abuse material (CSAM)
Agent Platform — FINISH_REASON_IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT: the image provided in the prompt was flagged for prohibited content
Agent Platform — FINISH_REASON_SPII: flagged for sensitive personally identifiable information

Note that the response is generated in sections, with each section separately evaluated for safety (said for model responses in general, not specifically for images).

When generation is blocked, finish_reason is not STOP and a finish_message is available — print both.

Failures surface at two levels — promptFeedback.blockReason (no candidates) and candidate finishReason (IMAGE_SAFETY, IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT, IMAGE_RECITATION, IMAGE_OTHER, NO_IMAGE); a client should check both.

ядра.подтема: safetySettings в запросе: категории, пороги, метод, оценки вероятности
ядра.ядро_en: safetySettings: per-request settings for blocking unsafe content — a list of SafetySetting (category + threshold [+ method]), no more than one setting per category; categories not listed use the default. Thresholds: OFF, BLOCK_NONE, BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE, BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE, BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH.

части.текст_en: category — Gemini API: HATE_SPEECH, SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT, DANGEROUS_CONTENT, HARASSMENT, CIVIC_INTEGRITY, JAILBREAK; Agent Platform: HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT, HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH, HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT, HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT

threshold — BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE: Content with NEGLIGIBLE will be allowed; BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE: NEGLIGIBLE and LOW allowed; BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH: NEGLIGIBLE, LOW, and MEDIUM allowed; BLOCK_NONE: All content will be allowed; OFF: Turn off the safety filter; Agent Platform: OFF 'Switches off safety if all categories are turned OFF'

method (Agent Platform) — 'Specify if the threshold is used for probability or severity score. If not specified, the threshold is used for probability score'; SEVERITY uses both probability and severity scores, PROBABILITY only the probability score
safety ratings in the response — HarmProbability NEGLIGIBLE / LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH ('This does not indicate the severity of harm'); blocked flag 'indicates if the model's input or output was blocked'

модели_различия.текст_en: Agent Platform: the Go/Java/REST image generation samples on gemini-2.5-flash-image pass a safety setting: method PROBABILITY, category HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT, threshold BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE (E-60-9) — sample values
Gemini API and Agent Platform references: image models are not named, applicability to image output is not stated
migration Imagen → Gemini Image (E-228-21)
in the Vertex/Agent Platform code samples with gemini-2.5-flash-image: method PROBABILITY, category HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT, threshold BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE (E-282-9, E-319-9)
Imagen: ImagenSafetySettings (E-228-21)
Firebase: a general item about safety settings, not specific to images (E-250-7, E-251-21)

оговорки.текст_en: Content filters 'let you set specific thresholds for common harm types'; categories such as sexual, hate, harassment and dangerous content; threshold per category based on probability and/or severity.
PRODUCT (Agent Platform console): 'you can select a safety filter threshold that sets how likely you are to see potentially harmful responses'.
The Agent Platform page 'Safety and content filters' that details these settings is for Gemini text generation models; image-generation safety is documented separately (see the core on that page).

Code samples (Java, Go, REST) calling gemini-2.5-flash-image pass a safety setting with method PROBABILITY, category HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT and threshold BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE (Python and Node.js samples set none) — this is an example, not a requirement.

Use safety settings to adjust the likelihood of getting responses that may be considered harmful, including hate speech and sexually explicit content; for Gemini Image models, safety settings configured for Imagen with ImagenSafetySettings need to be migrated to SafetySetting.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: Legitimate subjects (medicine, a weapon in a museum, swimwear advertising) are cut by the filter — or, conversely, a service for a child audience needs a strict threshold; the author decides what to put in safetySettings.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: Interactions API — custom safety settings are not supported there; Imagen — the safetySetting parameter is different (see the related cores).
ядра.магнит_причина: Lists of harm categories and BLOCK_* thresholds (including OFF and BLOCK_NONE) that name what is blocked.

термины.значение_en: a category's blocking threshold: OFF, BLOCK_NONE, BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE, BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE, BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH
PROBABILITY (default) or SEVERITY (probability + severity)
probability of being unsafe NEGLIGIBLE/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH; not the severity of harm
BLOCK_NONE lets everything through; OFF turns the filter off (Agent Platform: only if all categories are OFF)
filter settings in Gemini / in Imagen; on migration they must be moved to SafetySetting

ядра.подтема: Настраиваемые фильтры: отдельный слой, ложные срабатывания, на что действуют (промпт/ответ)
ядра.ядро_en: Configurable content filters are an independent layer from the model, so they are robust against jailbreaks. They lack fine-grained customization beyond threshold settings for predefined categories, may occasionally block benign content (false positives) or miss some harmful content (false negatives), and are only available for response filtering, not prompt filtering.

модели_различия.текст_en: Agent Platform (Safety pages 98/99 — two editions of the same page) and the Gemini API reference; no models named

оговорки.текст_en: Gemini API: safetySettings 'will be enforced on the GenerateContentRequest.contents and GenerateContentResponse.candidates… The API will block any contents and responses that fail to meet the thresholds'.
Agent Platform REST reference: safetySettings 'Enforced on GenerateContentResponse.candidates'.

Agent Platform beginner's guide: the platform 'checks both the prompt and response'; if a threshold is exceeded the response is blocked and a fallback response is returned (safety filters as the last layer); Agent Platform image page: a filter can flag the prompt and return BlockedReason.

Configurable filters give a base level of safety for user-facing applications or agents; 'If your goal is to ensure content and brand safety, content filters should be paired with system instructions.'

приёмы.текст_en: Because configurable filters act only on responses, prompt screening has to come from layers the page lists as inspecting inputs: DLP input protection, Model Armor, or Gemini as a filter.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The service accepts prompts from users, and the author expects the safetySettings threshold to cut off a bad prompt before generation.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: Built-in non-configurable filters and the model refusal — they also check the prompt (see the cores on prompt blocks and default protection).

термины.значение_en: configurable thresholds for predefined harm categories; a layer independent from the model
blocking benign content / missing harmful content

ядра.подтема: Где можно задать свои safety settings: OpenAI-совместимость — да, Interactions API — нет
ядра.ядро_en: Custom safety settings are not supported in the Interactions API. Via the OpenAI compatibility layer you can enable Grounding with Google Search and configure safety settings using the extra_body parameter: extra_body.safety_settings (Images endpoint) — custom safety threshold filters, e.g. [{"category": "HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH", "threshold": "BLOCK_NONE"}].

оговорки.текст_en: Custom safety thresholds and batch processing for image generation are available only through the legacy generateContent API, while all new models and features are to launch on the Interactions API.

ядра.подтема: Imagen: safetySetting, includeRaiReason, includeSafetyAttributes
ядра.ядро_en: safetySetting (optional) controls safety filter thresholds for generated images: block_low_and_above (highest threshold, most images filtered), block_medium_and_above (default, balanced), block_only_high (fewest blocks, may increase objectionable content). includeRaiReason (default true) enables the Responsible AI filtered reason code in responses with blocked input or output. includeSafetyAttributes (default false) returns rounded Responsible AI scores for a list of safety attributes for unfiltered input and output.

части.текст_en: safetySetting: block_low_and_above (previously block_most) / block_medium_and_above (default; previously block_some) / block_only_high (previously block_few)
includeRaiReason: default true

includeSafetyAttributes: default false; categories Death, Harm & Tragedy; Firearms & Weapons; Hate; Health; Illicit Drugs; Politics; Porn; Religion & Belief; Toxic; Violence; Vulgarity; War & Conflict

модели_различия.текст_en: Imagen (imagen-3.0-*, imagen-4.0-*); SDK sample edit_image on imagen-3.0-capability-001: safety_filter_level=BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE (E-85-45); Imagen 3 and imagegeneration@006 — user-configurable safety setting (E-61-58, E-61-67)

оговорки.текст_en: Release notes: Imagen 3 (Jul 31, 2024) and imagegeneration@006 (Apr 9, 2024) introduced user-configurable safety features — a safety setting and a person/face setting.

Python sample: client.models.edit_image(model='imagen-3.0-capability-001', config=EditImageConfig(edit_mode='EDIT_MODE_DEFAULT', number_of_images=1, safety_filter_level='BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE', person_generation='ALLOW_ADULT')).

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: Generation runs through Imagen, and the filter needs to be relaxed/tightened or the block reason code obtained.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: Gemini image models — their safetySettings take a different form (see the safetySettings core).
ядра.магнит_причина: Blocking thresholds (block_low_and_above, block_medium_and_above, block_only_high) name what gets filtered out.

ядра.ядро_en: Safety and responsibility was built into Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Image throughout the training and deployment lifecycle, including pre-training, post-training, and product-level mitigations. Mitigations include, but are not limited to: dataset filtering; conditional pre-training; supervised fine-tuning; reinforcement learning from human and critic feedback; safety policies and desiderata; product-level mitigations such as safety filtering.

оговорки.текст_en: Agent Platform's image generation capabilities are equipped with a multi-layered safety approach designed to prevent the creation of inappropriate content, including sexually explicit, dangerous, violent, hateful, or toxic material.

ядра.подтема: Многослойный подход к безопасности (Agent Platform): риски и слои
ядра.ядро_en: When deploying Gemini models, it's crucial to identify and mitigate various potential risks… A multi-layered approach to safety is critical. The combined approach combines multiple protective layers: input and output data redaction with Sensitive Data Protection, system instructions for brand and topic guidelines, configurable safety filters for predefined harms, and secondary inspection using Gemini as a filter — with additional cost and latency, to provide a robust level of safety for user-facing applications or agents, especially where adversarial and malicious use is expected.

Risks — brand safety (tone/values, competitors, reputational damage)
Risks — alignment (irrelevant or inaccurate content)
Risks — security and privacy (leaking training data or prompts; adversarial users overriding safety)
Layer — default model and non-configurable filters
Layer — system instructions
Layer — content filters
Layer — Gemini as a filter
Layer — Sensitive Data Protection / DLP
Layer — Model Armor
Layer — Content Credentials

ядра.подтема: Sensitive Data Protection (DLP) — защита входа и выхода, только текст
ядра.ядро_en: Input protection: before sending user prompts or data to Gemini, you can pass the text through the DLP API to redact or mask any sensitive information, which prevents it from being processed or logged by the model. Output protection: the model's output can be scanned by the DLP API before being sent to the user. The DLP API can inspect text… and can also be used to block keywords.

оговорки.текст_en: The DLP API inspects text (predefined and custom infoType detectors; redaction, masking, tokenization) — the page describes it for text only, not for images.
Adds latency and can lead to over-blocking; meant for agents that have access to sensitive data; addresses sensitive data leakage and enables custom block lists.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The users' prompt text may contain personal data (addresses, card numbers) that must not be passed to the model.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: Checking the images themselves — DLP is described only for text (see the Gemini-as-a-filter core).

ядра.подтема: Gemini как фильтр: второй вызов быстрой модели проверяет вход и готовый выход (в т.ч. картинки)
ядра.ядро_en: Gemini as a filter involves making a second call to a fast and cost-effective Gemini model (such as Gemini Flash or Flash-Lite) to evaluate whether the input from a user or tool, or the output from your primary Gemini model, is safe. The filter model is given instructions to decide if the content is safe or unsafe based on your defined policies including content safety, brand safety, and agent misalignment; it can analyze text, images, video, and audio.

модели_различия.текст_en: filter models — 'Gemini Flash or Flash-Lite' (not image models)

оговорки.текст_en: Additional cost and latency; chance of extremely rare false negatives; for a custom level of safety for user-facing applications or agents.

Offers an advanced, customizable checkpoint for complex or nuanced safety concerns that earlier layers might miss or that need context-aware evaluation; protects against content safety violations, brand safety issues, model drift and hallucinations.

приёмы.текст_en: For an image generation app, the only layer on these pages described as able to check generated images is Gemini as a filter; DLP works on text only.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The service delivers generated images to external users, and the finished frame must be checked against your own rules (brand, safety) before delivery.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: Checking only the prompt text for personal data — DLP (see the Sensitive Data Protection core).

ядра.подтема: Непрерывная оценка безопасности
ядра.ядро_en: Continuous safety evaluation is crucial for AI systems; the AI landscape and misuse methods are constantly evolving. Types of evaluations: development evaluations, assurance evaluations, red teaming, external evaluations, benchmark testing. The scope should cover content safety, brand safety, relevance, bias and fairness, truthfulness, and robustness to adversarial attacks. Iterative improvements, based on evaluation findings, are essential.

модели_различия.текст_en: Agent Platform Safety — general advice

оговорки.текст_en: Tools like the Gen AI evaluation service can assist; regular evaluations help identify vulnerabilities, assess mitigation effectiveness, adapt to evolving risks, ensure alignment with policies, build trust and maintain compliance.

ядра.ситуация_в_промпте: The generation pipeline runs continuously, and it must be checked periodically whether the protection lets new bypasses through.
ядра.не_применяется_когда: One-off generation.

словарь_терминов.значение_en: Google's invisible watermark in the pixels (content) of AI-generated media plus the technology to detect it; applied at the moment of creation to every image generated or edited with Nano Banana. Variants: the DeepMind page says 'across Google’s generative AI consumer products' (E-138-3), API and model pages say 'All generated images' (E-1-17); robustness for images is 'designed to stand up to' (E-138-8), stronger for audio (E-138-15); 2023 (Imagen): 'directly into the pixels of an image' (E-178-3); 2025–2026: 'directly into content generated by Google's AI models' (E-211-22) and 'imperceptible signals into AI-generated content' (E-294-2); the 2025 Photos post includes text among the modalities (E-327-2), the help page lists images, videos, audio.

Imagen parameter (not Nano Banana) that turns SynthID on, default true; seed works only when it is false; not supported for Gemini Image models, where the watermark is always applied. Variant: the console does not allow disabling it (E-120-7).

Cryptographically signed C2PA provenance metadata inside the file (a 'digital passport' of the file's origin and edit history, signed by a company); Google models sign automatically ('Google Media Processing Services'). Variants: 'C2PA metadata' (E-294-10), 'Content Credentials (C2PA)' (E-261-14, E-212-10), 'C2PA Content Credentials' (E-317-20, E-314-5) — the same thing on different pages; the Agent Platform Safety pages name only Gemini 3 Pro Image in the intro (E-98-13) while the Content Credentials page lists four models; the 2025-11 blog names only Pro on three surfaces (E-140-11).

The visible Gemini star/sparkle badge on images in the app — a product label on top of SynthID. Variants: 2025-08 — on all app images; 2025-11 — removed for Ultra and in Google AI Studio; the 2025-11 blog says 'visible watermark (the Gemini sparkle)' (E-260-41); the help page says 'visible watermarks' with the 'Media Watermark' setting (E-212-4); the Workspace blog says just 'watermark' without the type (E-231-11).

A refusal by the model itself: a text response instead of an image, FinishReason = STOP. Variants: notebook code treats only finish_reason != STOP as an error (E-75-9, E-76-16); E-292-11 says 'usually gives a text response saying it can't generate unsafe images', while E-227-74 and E-345-16 say 'return a response indicating that it can't create unsafe images' without 'usually'.

The API response field with the reason a prompt was blocked; when it is set, no candidates are returned. Variants: Agent Platform writes 'BlockedReason in PromptFeedback', the Gemini API 'promptFeedback.blockReason'; the IMAGE_SAFETY value is described as blocking candidates.

The reason a candidate stopped when a generated image is blocked: IMAGE_SAFETY, IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT, IMAGE_RECITATION, IMAGE_OTHER, NO_IMAGE (Gemini API); FINISH_REASON_SAFETY, …_IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT, …_SPII, etc. (Agent Platform); the list is open ('or similar'). Variant: IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT refers to the generated image (E-19-13, E-91-13) versus an image in the input (E-125-53) — disputed.
An error field with a message and a numeric filter category code (separate codes for the prompt and for the image). Variant: Imagen has includeRaiReason (E-120-18).

A list of category + threshold pairs in the request — the filter settings in Gemini; for Imagen, ImagenSafetySettings must be migrated to SafetySetting. Variants: Gemini API has 6 categories (including CIVIC_INTEGRITY, JAILBREAK), Agent Platform 4; Gemini API applies them to request and response, Agent Platform to the response.

Imagen parameter defining which people are allowed in the frame; not supported for Gemini Image models, where people are allowed by default. Variant: in 2023 faces were by default without children and celebrities (E-61-81) — replaced.

Qualifier of the 'celebrity' / 'celebrity or child' filters and of prominent_people: the Celebrity filter targets a photorealistic depiction of a celebrity. Variant: how non-photorealistic styles are treated is not stated (E-91-33).
Permission by list (for example for child content) granted to a project; the mechanism is not disclosed.

словарь_терминов.термин: Prohibited Use Policy (PUP) / Generative AI Prohibited Use Policy
словарь_терминов.значение_en: Google's mandatory policy on prohibited use of generative AI, with a list of prohibited content, binding on all generation users; a violation leads to PUP_LIMITED_DISABLED. Variants: model cards also refer to the Gemini API Additional Terms of Service; 'Generative AI Prohibited Use Policy' (E-292-2, E-248-17), 'Prohibited Use Policy' as part of the ToS (E-208-3), 'Gen AI Prohibited Use Policy' (E-169-40); product pages link to it as 'Create responsibly' (E-188-9, E-276-21).
A SynthID verification portal (for journalists and via a waitlist) that highlights the likely watermarked areas.
A Search feature that shows, from C2PA metadata and SynthID, whether an image was created or edited with AI.
SynthID mode of Nano Banana 2 Lite. Variants: the Gemini API model card says 'Always On', the blog 'enabled by default'; resolved by rank → always on.
A tool that preserves Content Credentials; an edit with a non-C2PA tool counts as tampering and fails validation. Variant: the Safety pages word it more softly: 'can compromise file authenticity'.
the source is confirmed and the file is unchanged; it does not mean 'a real photo'
Not explained for images; the default protection layer relates it to Copyrighted Content. Variant: Agent Platform FINISH_REASON_RECITATION — 'unauthorized citations'.

A category's blocking threshold. Variants: OFF — Gemini API 'Turn off the safety filter', Agent Platform 'Switches off safety if all categories are turned OFF'; Imagen has its own values block_low_and_above/… (E-120-23).
what the threshold is based on; probability by default
probability of being unsafe (NEGLIGIBLE…HIGH), not the severity of harm

Configurable thresholds for predefined categories; a layer independent from the model. Variants: Agent Platform — 'only for response filtering'; Gemini API — on request contents and response candidates (E-19-3).
Nano Banana 2: blocking photorealistic images of prominent people
European Economic Area — there Nano Banana does not generate images of children
Child Sexual Abuse Material — blocked by the default layer and by the PROHIBITED_CONTENT code
A Google Cloud service that screens LLM prompts and responses (paid). Variant: the models/safety-overview edition adds 'safe browsing'.
Finding and masking sensitive data in input/output text. Variant: one edition calls it 'Sensitive Data Protection', the other 'DLP'.
a second call to a fast Gemini model (Flash/Flash-Lite) as a safe/unsafe judge; it also analyzes images
instructions to the model about behaviour and forbidden topics; they do not guarantee compliance

споры.суть: IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT: про сгенерированную картинку или про картинку во входе

версии.текст: IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT — Image generation stopped because generated images has other prohibited content. (E-19-13; 2026-09-23, ранг 1)
If the response is identified as potentially harmful by a safety filter, the API response includes a FinishReason of IMAGE_SAFETY, IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT, or similar. (E-91-13; 2026-09-22, ранг 1)
FINISH_REASON_IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT: Token generation was stopped because the image provided in the prompt was flagged for prohibited content. (E-125-53; 2026-09-22, ранг 1)

сводка:
Вход: 95 ядер (ч1 — 46, ч2 — 45, из «другое» — 4: Я-другое-1-31, 1-32, 1-52, 1-55); выход: 77 ядер Я-безопасность-1…77, порядок по подтемам: SynthID → видимый знак и продукты → C2PA → проверка происхождения → отказы и блоки API → safetySettings и фильтры → Imagen → люди/дети → политики и данные → возраст → процесс Google → многослойная защита (Agent Platform, Firebase).
Слито 16 групп (34 старых ядра): части во многом дублировали друг друга, потому что одни и те же страницы извлечены дважды (стр. 91 = 292 «Gemini image generation and responsible AI», 137 = 263, 139 = 260, 140 = 294, 211 = 293 и др.); Я-другое-1-31 влито в ядро о признаках ИИ-картинки, Я-другое-1-32 — в ядро о списке моделей C2PA; ядро ч2 «выведено» Я-безопасность-2-29 стало приёмом в ядре об отказе модели (тот же вывод экстрактора, что приём ч1).
Не слиты по правилу (ж) продукт/API: права на загрузки, использование данных, дисклеймеры, проверка C2PA (сайт против Gemini Apps) — связи «уточняет». Оставлены раздельно со связями и вопросами сшивки пары, где ядро ч2 шире или составное: C2PA «что это» (1-9 / 2-14), 1-1 против ядра из 2-1 + 1-4, 1-18 против ядра из 2-28 + 1-19.
Спор один: Я-безопасность-34 (IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT — про сгенерированную картинку или про картинку во входе, спор ч1). Решения противоречий частей сохранены; одинаковое противоречие о видимом знаке из обеих частей объединено в одно; составные подписи правил («(а) модель; (б) дата», «а+б» и т.п.) сведены к решающей букве, остальные упомянуты в решении.
Переведено на английский 469 уникальных строк (ситуации, «не применяется», тексты ячеек моделей → модели_различия, оговорки/приёмы с русскими вставками, значения терминов, словарь); ссылки на коды ядер в английских полях заменены описаниями; для 20 ядер-магнитов написаны причины по-английски.
Модели сведены к да/нет/частично/не_сказано по правилам координатора (Imagen в ядре «SynthID не отключается» — «нет»); матрица — 16 строк, коды всех ячеек матриц частей есть в соответствующих ядрах. Словарь: 72 термина (15 групп из двух частей слиты); разрешение моделей — 55 решений (21 + 34); не_сведено — 40 (12 + 28).
